notes.title: Laundromat Simulator version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Bug Fixes
-Fixed bug where spills could spawn partially outside the laundromat.
-Fixed a bug where customers might not use available seating.
-Fixed a bug where some furniture could not be placed in the Tokyo apartment.
-Various other minor bugs.

Gameplay Changes
-Added the counting table to the Laundromat shop so you can purchase a new one if something has happened to the original.
-Performance Improvements.
-Added widescreen support.

notes.title: Laundromat Simulator Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.0
Hello everyone! We are happy to announce the release of version 1.1.0, bringing the London location as well as store customisation.

Changes
-Added London location which can be accessed via the change location button.
-Added store customisation which enables you to change the paint/material on the floors and walls.

Bug Fixes
-Fixed a UI bug that would make popup menu buttons have undefined behavior.

We hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Hotfix 5
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed an issue where the Mail banking upgrade did not save correctly.
-Fixed an issue where you could not count coins after moving the counting table.

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug where your rating could go above 5 stars, which would cause time to stop.
-Fixed a bug where customers would check if the store is decorated infinite times.
-Fixed an issue where cursor could disappear in the location selection screen.

Gameplay Changes
-You now only need to meet a certain amount of demands for a positive review, instead of all demands.
-Added popup explaining that vending machine supplies are required.

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
Gameplay changes
-Added trash can so which will reduce the chance of customers leaving trash in the laundromat.
-Added speed collection upgrade which lets you collect coins from machines much faster.

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

-Fixed game breaking issue where time would stop because no valid save data was found.
If you still run into this issue please let us know through the Steam Community discussions!

Gameplay Changes

-Changed skip time to sleep and added new tutorial for sleeping in bed. When you load your game it 
should have a tutorial explaining how to sleep after 9PM.

Thanks to those community members who have helped with bug fixing!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5
notes.notes:
0.9.5 Patch Notes

Bug fixes:

 Fixed Options bug when toggling fullscreen using alt-enter.
 Trash no longer spawns on top of one another.
 Variant UI on the laptop screen now displays correctly.
 A use time has been added to in store vending machine to prevent customers from using them at the same time.


Quality of life:

 Added a grid lock placement mode for items via holding shift.
 The change machine will now return all remaining cash to players when stored in inventory.
 A small yellow icon will now display next to your money balance if you are currently holding uncounted money.
 The counting table has now been made movable, however it cannot be stored in the inventory.
 Vending machines and change machines will only display top-up icon after placement.
 Item rotations on different surfaces (floor, wall, ect) are now saved when moving an item around between them.
 The counting table will not spawn a second money box if the previous one hasn’t been picked up.


Items:

 The vending machine, coffee machine, and drinks vending machine will now generate sales at a random range instead of a fixed one to better mimic real world behavior.


Visuals:

 The earth in the World Map scene now spins.
 Improved the interactions in the World Map.


Developer note

Hi everyone!

Lots of quality of life updates in this patch as we move closer and closer to release. Thank you everyone for your continued support and feedback. We'd just like to mention that due to the scale of changes in this patch, old save files will NOT work in this latest patch. We apologies for the inconvenience and look forward to your continued support.

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.4
notes.notes:
0.9.4 Patch Notes

Bug fixes:

 Reduced the amount of bills that spawn on the counting table to prevent lag when a lot of bills are collected.
 Fixed the mouse the disappearing outside interactable UI.
 Fixed a minor bug occurring when loading a new game after loading a save file.
 Fixed a bug related to placing seating items in the apartment being assigned to customers wanting to sit down.


Quality of life:

 Added FOV and Vsync settings to the options menu.
 Rubbish bags and money boxes can now be picked up while holding other rubbish bags and money boxes respectively.
 Counting tutorial had its description updated to be easier to understand.
 


Gameplay:

 Added a “Open/Close“ sign to the store which when set to closed, prevents new customers from entering the store and makes current customers leave after finishing their current task.


Developer note

Hi everyone!

Thanks to everyone who has tried the demo so far! We have added a close sign so now you can close the store to make changes without new customers getting in your way. We are going to focus more on fixing the core gameplay loop for the main game from now on, but we will still be looking out for any bugs or quick fixes we can implement in the demo. 

Please look forward to the full release!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.3
notes.notes:
0.9.3 Patch Notes

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a UI bug with the laptop that prevented interaction on initial usage.
 Fixed an autosave bug in which a badly timed autosave could break the game on scene transition.
 UI button click sound effects now adhere to the options SFX slider.
 Fixed the NPC interaction which resulted in them not moving to their designated targets and resulted in them being stuck in the store.


Quality of life:

 Moved the initial player spawn position to be in a more “aesthetic“ place.
 Implemented a UI element which lets the player know if their save file is outdated.
 Added multiple additional tutorials to explain game mechanics.


Known bugs:

 Placing a seating item (e.g. chair or couch) in your apartment leads to unexpected behavior.
 Counting table will lag the game out if too many notes are collected.
 Some floor items can be placed in a way that clips through the wall at certain angles


Developer note

Hi everyone!

Thank you again for playing our demo. We're working hard to stabilize the demo and will be releasing regular patches over the next few days. Thank you for all the feedback, we're taking it into account and looking into addressing your concerns/feedback.

We've finally fixed that frustrating "Customers getting stuck in the store/on chairs" bug that many of you had and are implementing more quality of life updates.  

Thank you so much for playing!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2
notes.notes:
0.9.2 Patch Notes

Bug fixes:

Fixed fatal bug with machines that use card

Fixed a variety of UI related bugs

Quality of life:

Moved laptop and counting table to backroom of laundromat

Added stats tooltip for machines

Added a placement restrictions indicator to the shop item detail panel to indicate where you are allowed to place an item.

Updated AlexList to look more like a second hand website.

Known bugs:

Placing a seating item (e.g. chair or couch) in your apartment leads to unexpected behavior.

NPCs can get stuck and either stay in the laundromat after finishing or sit down in mid-air in front of their machine.

Chairs can become unmovable after an NPC has already left the chair.

Developer note

Hi everyone!

I just wanted to give a huge thanks to everyone who has played the demo so far! We are very happy with the games performance so far and you can expect more updates, quality of life changes and bug fixes throughout Steam Next Fest.

We would love to hear any feedback or bug reports, both of which can be submitted via the links in the main menu of the game.

Also, a quick note, there is a skip time function in the pause menu that allows you to speed up gameplay. Sorry that was unclear! We will be updating the tutorials and adding much needed explanations for many mechanics very soon!

Again, thanks so much for playing!
